subject: Access to real-time telemetry & temporary sampling waiver
messages:
From: Elena Morozova <elena@brightwave.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-eng@brightwave.com
Date: 2026-11-19T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Procurement: telemetry access + temporary sampling waiver request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency tail and cache behavior we saw makes Redwood an interesting fit for the BrightWave inference use case. Procurement has a short checklist we need to close before a pilot: specifically around how SLOs are measured and what monitoring/access we get during onboarding.

Attached is our short questionnaire (BrightWave-slo-questionnaire.pdf). Key asks where we need quick confirmation:
- Read-only, near-real-time access to a per-tenant Grafana dashboard (p50/p95/p99, request rate, error rate) during pilot.
- Ability to request temporary "playback" or sample-level traces for up to 72 hours to validate cold-start and KV-cache miss behavior.
- Clarify alerting hooks (webhooks, PagerDuty) and whether alerts can be duplicated into our platform.
- Data retention and retention-limited exports for the pilot.

We know the sampling of raw traces can be sensitive — we can sign an NDA or a narrow addendum if that helps. Procurement would like a written statement of scope and a timeline for any temporary exceptions (start/end times). Also confirm whether a temporary sampling waiver affects SLA entitlements / credits.

Can we get a short plan and owner by EOD today? We are aiming to start the pilot on Monday.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightWave Analytics

Attachments: BrightWave-slo-questionnaire.pdf

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morozova <elena@brightwave.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: telemetry access + temporary sampling waiver request

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping Grace (SRE) and Priyom (Solutions) to own the technical plan; Marcus will cover contract/PO touchpoints. High-level answers up front:

1) Grafana access: we can provide a tenant-scoped read-only Grafana view with redacted PII and tenant IDs. This will be near-real-time (15–30s scrape cadence) and include p50/p95/p99 latency, request rate, error rate, KV cache hit ratio, and prefix-cache stats. We will share a calendar invite for a 30-minute walkthrough.

2) Temporary sampling/playback: Redwood can enable high-fidelity traces for a narrowly-scoped 48-hour window by default (we can stretch to 72 hours with legal OK). The scope will be limited to the pilot tenant namespace, and raw traces will be access-controlled. We require a signed DPA addendum to allow export of raw traces and a PO that covers the incremental storage cost. Details of the proposed scope attached (proposed-playback-scope.md).

3) Alerts / webhooks: we support webhook endpoints and PagerDuty integration. We can duplicate selected alert streams to BrightWave's ops endpoint; we'll need the webhook URL and a short alert mapping doc. Alerts are configurable by metric threshold and by anomaly rule.

4) SLA / waiver: enabling sampling for debugging does not change the contractual uptime/latency SLA itself. However, data collected under the sampling waiver will be used solely for onboarding diagnostics; we will not retroactively adjust historical SLA calculations. We'll include this in the addendum language.

Next steps I propose:
- Grace to open an ephemeral Grafana invite (read-only) and a monitoring token.
- Priyom to schedule a walkthrough for Monday.
- Marcus to start the DPA addendum and verify PO flow.

Can Grace or Priyom confirm timelines below?

— Jasmine
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-playback-scope.md

From: Elena Morozova <elena@brightwave.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-eng@brightwave.com
Date: 2026-11-19T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: telemetry access + temporary sampling waiver request

Thanks Jasmine — that reads well. Two clarifications from our side before we sign anything:

1) Playback window: BrightWave would prefer the full 72 hours for capture of both weekday and weekend tail behavior. If legal requires 48, we can accept 48 for the first run and a second 48h run later; priority is being able to see the p99 spikes across traffic patterns.

2) Metrics set: our performance team specifically needs KV cache hit-rate, prefix-cache effectiveness, per-backend latency (model inference vs routing), and the request-size distribution. Can those be included in the Grafana view?

3) Alert duplication: we want the same alert thresholds as Redwood's ops team for the pilot, and a copy of alert events pushed to ops-eng@brightwave.com. Will Redwood redact any identifiers in webhook payloads? If so, please list which fields are redacted.

4) SLA credits language: please confirm the exact statement to include in the addendum — specifically that enabling temporary sampling does not reduce SLA entitlements and will not be used as a basis to withhold credits should an availability event occur.

If you can confirm the above, Procurement will route the DPA addendum today. We can also take a 20-minute call at 2pm PT to sign-off.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: acceptance-email (inline)

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morozova <elena@brightwave.com>, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: telemetry access + temporary sampling waiver request

Hi Elena — Grace on SRE. Short answers and operational plan: 

- Playback window: we can do 72 hours for the first run on a case-by-case basis if Marcus confirms the DPA addendum AND we have a PO covering incremental storage. We will mark the traces as "ephemeral-debug" and auto-delete after 7 days from the end of the window (audit record retained).

- Metrics: we'll add KV cache hit-rate, prefix-cache effectiveness, per-backend latency (split by model-inference vs routing), and request-size histograms to the tenant Grafana dashboard. Sample names: rw.kv.cache.hit_ratio, rw.cache.prefix_effectiveness, rw.latency.inference_ms_by_model, rw.request.size_hist. We'll share the dashboard JSON before the walkthrough.

- Webhook redaction: webhook payloads will redact tenant_id and any user identifiers by default. Payload fields retained: metric name, timestamp, value, severity, and a short text summary. We can provide a redaction matrix: {tenant_id: redacted, user_id: redacted, request_id: preserved}. We'll provide the matrix as part of the addendum.

- SLA credits language: per Jasmine, enabling the sampling waiver does not change SLA entitlements. Proposed clause for addendum: "Redwood's temporary telemetry collection for onboarding diagnostics is permitted under this agreement and will not be considered a modification of uptime or latency SLOs nor a basis for denying SLA credits for covered incidents." Marcus will draft exact contract text.

Operational items we're executing now: 
1) Create Grafana read-only invite: https://redwood.example.com/grafana/invite/ephemeral-abc123 (expires in 10 days). Invite will be sent after DPA ack.
2) Generate ephemeral monitoring token scoped to the tenant (valid 72h from activation).
3) Schedule 30-minute walkthrough Monday 9:00am PT (calendar invite attached).

If you want 2pm PT today instead of Monday we can try to make that work — I have a slot at 2:15pm.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: grafana-invite.ics
